topic.title: Boot From Hub-die E-Core

body.p: Nova Lake processor family is the start of a new desktop socket compatibility. The forward compatibility feature enables fallback boot path with E-cores in the GMH (Graphics and Memory Hub) die when a new compatible CPU is plugged-in.
To boot from a Hub-die E-core, all C-dies need to be disabled through Early Power On Configuration (EPOC) 2 interface. Refer to Processor EDS vol2 for EPOC/EPOC2 register definitions.
